originalGrowth: A public letter counter gains carrier bays and an open sorting yard, then links whole dispatch halls across the parcel.

name: Poultry Farm
originalGrowth: One henhouse becomes rows of laying houses with free-range yards of wandering hens, a feed silo, egg truck and duck pond.

name: Preschool & Daycare
originalGrowth: Playroom → Discovery yard → Storybook wing → Adventure playground → Children’s village

name: Pretty Road
originalGrowth: Cobblestone boulevard that blooms with flower verges, avenue trees, baskets and fountain roundabouts.

name: Prison
originalGrowth: Sprawls: more cell blocks, more searchlight towers, a bigger yard and track, a workshop, then a legendary centerpiece.

name: Public Library
originalGrowth: A book-sized reading nook gains a covered porch or passage. Later volumes shelter a reading court, then an open-air commons. The final athenaeum has a roof garden, glass atlas spine, book-lined square or paper-tree balconies.

name: Public Works Directorate
originalGrowth: More inspection bays fill the open shed as the engineering wing, reservoir or lifting gantry grows overhead.

name: Pumped-Storage Station
originalGrowth: A powered station stores surplus electricity using two basins and returns it during shortages.

name: Rainwater Cathedral
originalGrowth: Vaulted collectors fill drinking-water reserves with treated rain and attract visitors.

name: Recycling Center
originalGrowth: Neighborhood collection bins expand into a solar-roofed sorting hall with conveyor bridges and neat material bales.

name: Redwood Tree
originalGrowth: Buttress roots and high boughs carry the ancient giants above a timber observation walk.

name: Regional Airport
originalGrowth: A grass airstrip with a prop plane paves into a runway with a village terminal, then gains jet bridges, a radar tower and runway lights, a long concourse and finally a curved crescent terminal with four jets.

name: Reindeer Stable
originalGrowth: The barn lengthens as new animals, rails and feeding stations fill the paddock.

name: Research Institute
originalGrowth: Instrument lab → Glass atrium → Observatory → Survey array → National laboratory

name: Research University
originalGrowth: Laboratory → Cleanroom → Research dome → Instrument tower → Discovery campus

name: Restaurant
originalGrowth: A counter grows into a full-service destination where the meal becomes the architecture.

name: Pixel Arcade Hall
originalGrowth: A cabinet nook grows into a building shaped like the game itself: a walk-in controller, a cabinet tower crowned by a spinning token, a pixel creature, or a pinball palace.

name: Classic Chrome Diner
originalGrowth: A chrome lunch car grows into a full roadside diner: stainless railcars with a clock pylon, a red drum marquee, a Googie drive-in under a starburst, or a rooftop of giant neon letters and a spinning coffee cup.

name: Rice Farm
originalGrowth: One paddy becomes a grid of flooded fields patrolled by ducks, a waterwheel and finally terraces stepping up the slope.

name: Crisis Command Center
originalGrowth: An operations bunker adds armored rescue vans, satellite uplinks and a rooftop command helipad.

name: River
originalGrowth: Meandering river whose banks grow reeds, rocks, willows and a fishing jetty.

name: Roads
originalGrowth: Kerbed asphalt street that gains lamps, street trees, hydrants, bus stops, signals and flower planters.

name: Duplex Cottage
originalGrowth: A pair of mirrored starter cottages expands with upper gables, shared chimneys, flower boxes and courtyard stairs.

name: Sail Boat
originalGrowth: Rig grows: one little sail → sloop → two-masted schooner → square-rigged brigantine → full-rigged three-master.

name: Sand
originalGrowth: Hand-built sand towers gather walls, then a moat, drawbridge and a pennant.

name: Santa’s House
originalGrowth: Its hearth grows into a broad manor with outbuildings and Santa on the doorstep.

name: Santa’s Sleigh
originalGrowth: A longer sleigh, bigger gift load and more harnessed reindeer join the Christmas Eve run.

name: Santa’s Toy Workshop
originalGrowth: The toy sign, production line, chimneys and colorful output grow with each level.

name: School
originalGrowth: The bell tower becomes a campus clock above classrooms, a playing field and a university quad.

name: Waterfront Seafood Pier
originalGrowth: A dockside counter gains a kitchen and a working float. Dining wings and covered markets grow around a lobster bridge, glazed lookout, auction court or twin pincer gates.

name: Air & Mountain Rescue
originalGrowth: A timber ranger post expands with a bright rescue helipad, beacon tower and weather-tracking domes.

name: Ship Building Area
originalGrowth: Inclined slipways multiply; hulls grow from bare ribs to planked ships, with sheds, derricks and a launch-day crowd.

name: Shipyard
originalGrowth: Dry-dock basins with gantry cranes grow taller; hulls get bigger and the yard adds sheds, jib cranes and a second dock.

name: Shoe Store
originalGrowth: A shoe sign on a kiosk grows into a shoe you can walk into, then a matched pair or a towering colossus: sneaker, shoebox stack, stiletto or cowboy boot.

name: Shops
originalGrowth: A single boutique gains neighboring sellers, a walkable shopping lane and a market quarter around its original counter.

name: Shoreline Overlook
originalGrowth: A quiet cliffside bench grows into a cantilevered timber viewing deck with stone retaining walls, scopes and lanterns.

name: Shrubs
originalGrowth: Potted specimens frame a gate, then circle a formal fountain in a sculpted garden.

name: Sidewalk
originalGrowth: Paved pedestrian esplanade adding planters, benches, lamps, bike racks and fountain plazas.

name: Skybridge University
originalGrowth: Suspended lecture halls train skilled workers and generate passenger demand.

name: Skyscraper
originalGrowth: The lobby grows into a landmark with observation decks, a signature crown and a beacon visible across town.

name: Smithsonian
originalGrowth: Sandstone galleries fan outward into an asymmetric skyline of turrets.

name: Solar Canopy Orchard
originalGrowth: Panel petals harvest sunshine over fruit rows, sharing land for power and food.

name: Solar Farm
originalGrowth: Rows multiply across a widening field, adding inverters, a substation and battery yard — then a glowing power tower with a mirror field.

name: Solar Panels
originalGrowth: Starts as a couple of panels, gains a panel-roofed shed, then sprawls into fenced rows with inverters and a battery bank.

name: Solar Spire Arcology
originalGrowth: A tiered solar atrium spirals skyward with cantilevered forest terraces, wind-turbine portals and a blazing solar crown.

name: Spaceport
originalGrowth: Staffed crews roll out and launch a rocket using power, water and a timed countdown.

name: Speed Boat
originalGrowth: Jet skis grow into runabouts, offshore racers with single or tunnel hulls, flybridge cruisers and finally tiered megayachts with a helipad and jacuzzi.

name: School Sports Field
originalGrowth: Practice pitch → School league → Athletics oval → Floodlit stands → Championship ground

name: Artisan Spring House
originalGrowth: A humble stone spring basin acquires an arched masonry roof, copper spout, wooden trough and surrounding ferns.

name: B-2 Stealth Airbase
originalGrowth: Single hardened clamshell bays expand into a secretive stealth wing with parked and flying B-2 Spirit wings.

name: Cloister Abbey
originalGrowth: A small stone priory grows into a full four-sided cloister framing a central herb garden and buttressed abbey nave.

name: Stone Bridge
originalGrowth: Masonry arch bridge that gains coped parapets, lanterns, flower boxes, statues and gilding.

name: Stonehenge
originalGrowth: Timber posts give way to a sarsen ring, lintels and trilithons, then a torchlit solstice axis with druids.

name: B-52 Bomber Airbase
originalGrowth: A heavy concrete strip grows giant bomber hangars, parked B-52 Stratofortresses and high-altitude sky flyovers.

name: Submarine Base
originalGrowth: A floating pier becomes a blast-door bunker with more and longer pens, cranes, radar, sonar dome and a missile transporter.

name: Submarine
originalGrowth: Low black hulls grow longer: bubble mini-sub → attack subs → missile sub with open hatches → twin-hull leviathan.

name: Supertree Grove
originalGrowth: A single planted tower gains companions, elevated walks, forked canopy lights and a four-tree grove.

name: Suspension Bridge
originalGrowth: Suspension span whose towers soar higher every level, adding art-deco tiers, necklace lights and beacons.

name: Swamp
originalGrowth: Shallows fill with roots and reeds around a raised boardwalk and wildlife hide.

name: SWAT Team HQ
originalGrowth: Armored vans and a rappelling tower grow into a compound with climbing wall, shooting range, kill-house and helicopters.

name: Synagogue
originalGrowth: Star of David façade grows a portico, towers and a dome, with a glowing menorah in the garden.

name: Tax Collecting Office
originalGrowth: A rolling coin rises above a round vault door, an armored van and fortified repositories.

name: Taxi Depot
originalGrowth: A rank of yellow cabs grows a checker garage, a radio mast, a stacked parking deck and a giant rooftop taxi.

name: Taxi Rank
originalGrowth: A signed curb gains a styled shelter, a waiting cab, a dispatch kiosk with a radio mast, and finally a giant glowing rooftop landmark — the boarding strip by the street always stays open.

name: Tech Startup Campus
originalGrowth: A small prototype lab opens visitor galleries and test workshops, then links the campus with elevated walks.

name: Teleportation Depot
originalGrowth: Two powered depots charge and transfer passengers between partner gates.

name: Temple
originalGrowth: A small shrine gains halls, then a tower (pagoda / shikhara / chedi), a great gate, and finally a sacred pond complex.

name: Terraced Glasshouses
originalGrowth: One glass cloche becomes twin ferneries, a petal-shaped dome hothouse, then glasshouses climbing three and four terraces crowned by a great glowing dome.

name: The Great Pyramids
originalGrowth: A mastaba grows into stepped and cased pyramids, with a carved sphinx guarding the royal causeway.

name: The London Eye
originalGrowth: A hand-sized pier wheel expands its rotating ring, passenger capsules and riverside boardwalk.

name: Thrift Store
originalGrowth: A few finds on a table become a shop, an outdoor exchange and a bazaar for the whole district.

name: Tidal Pool Boardwalk
originalGrowth: Natural rocky tidal basins gain low cedar walkways, interpretive signs, sea-grass tufts and sunlit tide pools.

name: Tidal Sluice Gate
originalGrowth: A gated timber weir grows twin stone hoist towers, geared steel sluice leaves, a footbridge and lantern beacons.

name: Tidal Turbine Array
originalGrowth: A single submerged current rotor multiplies into a linked offshore row with service catwalks and navigation beacons.

name: Tiny Home
originalGrowth: Sprawls into a tiny-home community: more units, shared fire pit & garden, then a wind turbine.

name: Townhome
originalGrowth: The row gets longer and taller, gains stoops, street trees and lamps, then a second row around a mews garden.

name: Trade & Technical College
originalGrowth: Workshop → Machine shop → Apprentice bays → Fabrication crane → Technical works

name: Highway Patrol Precinct
originalGrowth: A roadside trooper booth expands into a wide garage lined with pursuit cruisers and radio masts.

name: Trailer Home
originalGrowth: Sprawls: more trailers and pads, an access road, a park office, then a pool and neon sign.

name: Trail
originalGrowth: Earthen trail whose woodland thickens into an ancient forest with signposts, log steps and cairns.

name: Train Depot
originalGrowth: More tracks and sheds, a spinning turntable, sidings full of wagons and a signal box, then a gantry-crane rail works.

name: Train Stop
originalGrowth: A sign on a platform gains a canopy, then a station house, a clock tower and finally a vaulted boarding hall beside the live railway.

name: Train Tracks
originalGrowth: Railway that upgrades from timber ties to concrete, signals, overhead catenary and fenced high-speed slab track.

name: Streetcar Station
originalGrowth: A modest platform shelter grows overhead catenary arches, twin boarding bays, clock gables and resting trams.

name: Trash Burning Plant
originalGrowth: A smoky furnace shed becomes a tipping-hall plant with an ever-taller stack, then gas cleaning and an iconic landmark roof or tower.

name: Trash Compacting Plant
originalGrowth: Coloured skips become a baling shed, then a sorting hall with conveyors and bale yards, a compactor tower, and finally a solar-roofed eco hub.

name: Trees
originalGrowth: New branches spread into a shade canopy above a path, a bench and a rope swing.

name: Tumbleweeds
originalGrowth: Wind rolls open tangles of brush past a ranch fence and turns a prairie windpump.

name: Two Lane Road
originalGrowth: Wide double-yellow arterial that adds lighting, green bike lanes, bus stops and smart signals.

name: Underpass
originalGrowth: Sunken road between retaining walls that gets a covered lid, tunnel lights and a park on top.

name: University
originalGrowth: Founders hall → Reading cloister → Clock tower → Residential courts → Collegiate quadrangle

name: Vegetable Farm
originalGrowth: Raised beds by a shed grow into a homestead with crop strips, a packing shed, windpump and a market co-op of awning stalls.

name: Vegetable Field
originalGrowth: Seed beds sprout into full rows with drip lines and a spinning sprinkler, then crates, pickers and allotment sheds.

name: Vertical Farm
originalGrowth: A grow room stacks floor upon glowing floor into a sky harvest tower with a rooftop turbine.

name: Villa
originalGrowth: Adds a vine pergola, a pool, a tower and vineyard/grove, then formal fountain gardens and a gate.

name: Vineyard
originalGrowth: Trellis rows spread from a press house to an estate villa with barrels, sheep mowing the rows and a tasting terrace.

name: Walking Path
originalGrowth: Edged gravel footpath gaining lamps, benches, strollers, flowerbeds and a vine pergola.

name: Washington Monument
originalGrowth: Marble courses climb over a widening flag circle and reflecting mall.

name: Water Plaza
originalGrowth: A single basin grows tiers and satellite pools, then a light-up jet show, then a monumental stepped cascade.

name: Water Pumping Station
originalGrowth: From a shed on an intake pier to a pump hall with mains, a surge tower, transformer yard and rooftop tanks.

name: Water Reuse Works
originalGrowth: A reed filter pond adds a clarifier with a rotating skimmer bridge, then cascading reed terraces, a steaming cooling channel and finally rotating drum filters and a glowing clean-water tower.

name: Water
originalGrowth: Open water that fills with lily pads, leaping fish, ducks and finally a glowing crystal lagoon.

name: Water Tower
originalGrowth: The tank climbs higher every level; at Lv4 it gets a pump house and big lettering, Lv5 becomes a beacon-topped titan.

name: Water Plant
originalGrowth: Adds spinning clarifier rings, then a signature tower/digesters, then trucks, tanks and a fenced mega-campus.

name: Well
originalGrowth: Rope well gains a roof and winch, then a hand pump, a spinning wind pump, and finally a waterfall spring shrine.

name: White House
originalGrowth: A columned residence sprouts working wings, rose beds and a fountain lawn.

name: Wide River
originalGrowth: Broad river that forms sandbar islands, channel buoys and finally carries barges.

name: Wind Farm
originalGrowth: More turbines spread across a widening landscape, joined by tracks, a substation, met mast and transmission pylons.

name: Wind Turbine
originalGrowth: The same tower shoots higher each level while its blades grow longer, gaining beacons, platforms and a nacelle helipad.

name: Windmill
originalGrowth: From a little post mill to a tall gallery mill, then a miller's house and finally a second mill and village fields.

name: Zen Torii Shrine
originalGrowth: A lone vermilion torii expands with stone lanterns, raked zen gravel, a curved-roof hall and shimmering koi water.
